known_answer: Two views are MEASURED with the values below; the third is NOT_MEASURED with a reason. A consumer that returns two rows instead of three has silently dropped the view it could not measure.

records.reason: The declared view setup_tt_025c_5v00 has no report in this fixture. Nothing was read, so nothing can be said about the tt corner.

must_not.forbidden: a `value` key on the NOT_MEASURED record
must_not.why: contract §2: NOT_MEASURED carries a reason, not a value

must_not.forbidden: value 0, 0.0, -1 or "" for the tt view
must_not.why: contract §2: no numeric sentinels — 0 ns of setup slack is a real and alarming measurement, not a way to say nothing was measured
contract §2: a report prints the literal NOT_MEASURED row; it does not omit it. An omitted row makes an unmeasured corner look like a corner nobody needed.

must_not.forbidden: entering the tt row into a numeric comparison
must_not.why: contract §2: only MEASURED may enter a numeric comparison
